newsitem.title: FRANCE: Guerrillas kill newspaper manager in Algiers.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas kill newspaper manager in Algiers.

text.p: Moslem guerrillas shot dead the manager of Algeria's main mass circulation newspaper early on Tuesday as he was leaving his home in Algiers, an official Algerian statement said.

Algerian security forces named the victim as 43-year-old Mokrane Hamoui, manager of Echourouk newspaper. He was killed at 8.15 a.m (0715 GMT) inside his car in Jolie-Vue suburb in the southwest of Kouba, a hotbed of Moslem guerrilla activity on the heights of Algiers.

He was at least the third staff member of the Echourouk to be killed in the past three years. Two women journalists, working for Echourouk, were shot dead before. At least 60 journalists and media employees have been killed since June 1993.
Moslem guerrillas battling to topple the authorities see media employees -- whose reports on security are subject to harsh censorship -- as supporting the authorities.
